text.id: Laut pagi itu rata kayak kaca. Sri Rejeki ninggalin dermaga pelan-pelan, dan jejak airnya panjang banget, kayak nggak mau putus.
text.en: The sea is flat as glass that morning. The Sri Rejeki pulls away from the jetty slowly, and its wake is so long, as if it doesn't want to break.

caption.id: Sekar berdiri di buritan. Dia ngangkat satu tangan. Gue juga.
caption.en: Sekar stands at the stern. She raises one hand. So do I.

text.id: Waktu polisi merapat, cuma ada gue di ujung dermaga. Didit senyum, kayak orang yang dateng ke pesta dan ternyata salah tanggal.
text.en: When the police dock, there's only me at the end of the jetty. Didit smiles, like a man who came to a party and got the date wrong.

text.id: Mereka nyari ke semua rumah di dermaga bakau. Nggak ketemu apa-apa. Sepupu Pak Hendra bilang dia nggak pernah lihat perempuan berjaket hijau.
text.en: They search every house by the mangrove jetty. They find nothing. Pak Hendra's cousin says she's never seen a woman in a green jacket.

text.id: Tasya ngelihat gue kayak mau mukul. Dia nggak mukul. Dia cuma duduk di sebelah gue sampai kapal pulang.
text.en: Tasya looks at me like she wants to hit me. She doesn't. She just sits next to me until the boat home.

text.id: Rekamannya ikut ke Tidung, di dalam kotak seng. Episode 12 nggak pernah tayang. Patok-patok baru tetep nambah, satu-satu, kayak jahitan.
text.en: The recording went to Tidung, in a tin box. Episode 12 never aired. New stakes kept going in, one at a time, like stitches.

text.id: Tapi tiap Sabtu, jam lima kurang dua, HP gue geter. Nomor yang sama. Satu foto. Laut yang rata, dari tempat yang nggak pernah dia sebut.
text.en: But every Saturday, at two minutes to five, my phone buzzes. The same number. One photo. Flat sea, from a place she never names.

text.id: Gue selalu bales. Kadang satu kata. Kadang foto Pluit. Gue nggak pernah telat bales.
text.en: I always reply. Sometimes one word. Sometimes a photo of Pluit. I'm never late replying.

summary.id: Raka menemukan Sekar, lalu membiarkannya pergi ke Tidung bersama Pak Hendra. Rekamannya tidak pernah keluar dari pulau, tapi setiap Sabtu subuh ada satu foto laut.
summary.en: Raka found Sekar, then let her go to Tidung with Pak Hendra. The recording never left the island, but every Saturday at dawn there's one photo of the sea.
